categories.label: Reply Needed
categories.description: The email expects a response or action from the user (e.g., questions, meeting requests, action items, direct conversations).

categories.label: Already Replied
categories.description: The user has already sent a reply in this thread after the last incoming message addressed to them.

categories.label: Draft in Progress
categories.description: The user has started drafting a reply, but it has not been sent yet.

categories.label: Promotions
categories.description: Marketing emails, deals, newsletters, offers, or broadcast content from companies or services.

categories.label: Info (FYI)
categories.description: Informational notifications, receipts, shipping updates, order confirmations, automated alerts, system notifications — no response needed.

categories.label: Junk
categories.description: Spam, irrelevant content, or unsolicited messages with no value.
